web_description_html:
Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg is a chelated magnesium supplement designed for high tolerability and absorption. Each vegetable capsule delivers 200 mg of magnesium bisglycinate to support essential bodily functions.

  • Helps to maintain proper muscle function, including the heart muscle.
  • Helps in the development and maintenance of bones and teeth.
  • Helps to prevent magnesium deficiency.
  • Helps in energy metabolism and in tissue formation.

Brand Notes: Vegan, gluten free, non-GMO. Chelated form chosen for tolerability.

Serving Size: 1 capsule, 1 to 2 times daily.

NPN 80098765

Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Some people may experience diarrhoea.
